entries.notes: Search snippets confirm that p-B11 fusion experiments use 99.9% B-11 isotopic purity (e.g. LPP Fusion using decaborane at 99.9% B-11 / 99.9999% chemical purity). Natural boron (80.1% B-11) is insufficient — enrichment is required, which has supply-chain implications at commercial scale since the B-11 enrichment industry is currently sized for semiconductor ion implantation (kg/year), not fusion (tonnes/year). The arXiv system code paper should provide quantitative analysis of fuel requirements.

entries.notes: G-5 remains partial: no source documents achieved wall-plug efficiency for a DPSSL system at IFE-relevant operating conditions. Both extracted sources document the 10% WPE as a design goal or diode-level efficiency metric, not a demonstrated end-to-end result. Mercury laser (15013216) is the best available analogue — it explicitly targets 10% WPE at 10 Hz, 100 J for IFE use, consistent with HB11's claimed target. The 2025 diode pumps paper (3008974) provides the most current view of pump diode efficiency requirements. Marvel Fusion's specific DPSSL WPE remains uncharacterized in public sources — this appears to be a genuine information gap rather than a missed source.
